vendor/remote-lib.js is a bundle of these open-source libraries, used for the phone remote:

- trystero 0.27.0 and @trystero-p2p/core, @trystero-p2p/nostr (MIT) - https://github.com/dmotz/trystero
- @noble/secp256k1 (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2019 Paul Miller (paulmillr.com)
- qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase

Each is released under the MIT License: permission is granted, free of charge, to use, copy,
modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense and/or sell copies, provided the copyright
notice and this permission notice are included. The software is provided "as is", without
warranty of any kind.

vendor/nostr-lib.js is a bundle of these open-source libraries, used to sign the encrypted notes
that keep favorites in sync between devices:

- nostr-tools 2.26.1 (Unlicense, public domain) - https://github.com/nbd-wtf/nostr-tools
- @noble/curves 2.0.1 and @noble/hashes 2.0.1 (MIT) - Copyright (c) 2022 Paul Miller (paulmillr.com)

vendor/mpegts.js is mpegts.js 1.8.0 (Apache-2.0), used for TikTok LIVE's FLV stream - https://github.com/xqq/mpegts.js
A copy of the Apache License 2.0 is in vendor/mpegts.LICENSE.txt.
